lean.quote: As we'll see, the supporting evidence still leans risk on, however its impossible to ignore the drag of the the Nasdaq.
lean.note: Bull case conditional on 767.50 holding; full bearish sequence also spelled out.

calls.quote: The daily trend remains up as long as 767.50 holds.
The bottom of the flag has been reclaimed at 767.5 and is now a must hold level moving forward. If lost, the daily trend threatens flipping to down

The bearish sequence begins with acceptance below 767.50, followed by an hourly lower high and a break of 762.00. That would flip the short-term trend down and open a deeper weekly higher-low test near 760.00 or 754.75.
The expected move is neutral, with an upper bound of 778.57 and a lower bound of 761.70.
The previous all-time high near 760.00 remains the first major support.
707.00 is the important dividing line. Above it, neutral chop remains possible. Below it, the potential lower high and head-and-shoulders structure become much more threatening.
Semiconductors produced the market's most concerning chart, with a lower high, a lower low and a declining 50-day SMA creating downside risk toward 551.00.
